_about: Why each class and relation exists, the alternatives considered, and who confirmed it.

Contract.question: Which contracts do we hold?
Contract.validated_by: Claude, for the end-to-end test of 2026-11-19
Contract.why: Spending is committed by contracts, and each one ends.

Obligation.question: What does a contract oblige?
Obligation.validated_by: Claude, for the end-to-end test of 2026-11-19
Obligation.why: A contract is kept or broken obligation by obligation.

obliges.question: What does a contract oblige?
obliges.validated_by: Claude, for the end-to-end test of 2026-11-19
obliges.why: The obligations are the contract, read as things to do.

supplied_by.alternatives: A Supplier class here: rejected, the suppliers graph already holds suppliers and two copies would drift.
supplied_by.question: Who supplies a contract?
supplied_by.validated_by: Claude, for the end-to-end test of 2026-11-20
supplied_by.why: A contract is with someone. The supplier is another team's record, so the contract points at it and does not copy it.
